for_real_child: stature: Barefoot against a wall, book flat on the crown, mark the wall, measure mark to floor. Need ±1.0 cm; only a size-chart guess (±3.8 cm).
chest: Tape level under the arms and over the shoulder blades; read on a normal breath out. Need ±1.0 cm; only a size-chart guess (±3.0 cm).
back_neck_to_waist: Head bent forward to find C7; tape straight down the spine to the ribbon's lower edge. Need ±1.0 cm; only a size-chart guess (±1.5 cm).
neck_base: Tape round the base of the neck where a T-shirt neckband sits: over the C7 bump and the breastbone notch. Need ±0.5 cm; only a size-chart guess (±1.5 cm).
across_back: Find the bony shoulder tips (mark them); tape across the back from tip to tip, arms hanging. Need ±1.0 cm; only a size-chart guess (±1.6 cm).
shoulder_length: From where the neck meets the shoulder to the bony shoulder tip. Need ±0.5 cm; only a size-chart guess (±0.6 cm).
arm_length: Elbow slightly bent, hand on tummy; shoulder tip over the elbow to the wrist bone. Need ±1.0 cm; only a size-chart guess (±1.3 cm).
upper_arm: Arm hanging relaxed; tape round the thickest part halfway shoulder–elbow. Need ±0.5 cm; only a size-chart guess (±1.4 cm).
hand_pass: Thumb tucked to the palm; tape round the widest part of the hand (knuckles and thumb base). Need ±0.5 cm; only a size-chart guess (±1.0 cm).
